row:
Hello, I am Ermioni, and I am from Karditsa, Greece. I rescue animals that are found abandoned, abused, mistreated and starving, and I am trying to offer them a better life. All rescue animals receive the necessary medical care, they are vaccinated, neutered and spayed, and promoted for adoption. The more animals are adopted out, the more I can rescue. 

For adoptions please email me at: ermionirescue@gmail.com
